title: How to welcome new members on Discord: built-in tools, welcome bots and member approval

sections.title: General community
items: Welcome to {server}, {user}! 👋
Start by reading #rules, it takes one minute.
Pick your roles in #roles to see the channels that interest you.
Say hi in #general and tell us how you found us.
Questions? Ask in #help, someone will answer.

sections.title: Study group or class
items: Welcome to {server}, {user}! 📚
Read #rules and the pinned message in #start-here first.
Pick your subjects or your class in #roles.
Study sessions are announced in #events: join any of them.
Stuck on something? Post your question in #help with what you already tried.

sections.title: Creator community
items: Hey {user}, welcome to {server}! 🎬
New content is posted in #announcements: turn on notifications so you don't miss it.
Share your own work in #showcase and give feedback to others.
Please read #rules before posting links.
Want to collaborate? Introduce yourself in #introductions.

sections.title: Esports team or competitive community
items: Welcome to {server}, {user}! 🏆
Read #rules and check #schedule for practices and matches.
Set your game and rank in #roles to find people at your level.
Looking for a team? Post in #looking-for-team.
Tryouts are announced in #announcements.

sections.title: Gaming community
items: {user} just joined {server}! 🎮
Read #rules, then grab your game roles in #roles.
Find people to play with in #lfg.
Server events and game nights are in #events.
Report a problem or a player in #support.

sections.title: Support or help community
items: Welcome to {server}, {user}! 💬
Before asking, search #faq: most answers are already there.
Post your question in #help with as much detail as you can.
Be patient: everyone here helps on their free time.
Please read #rules, especially the part about pinging.
